import copy
def snap(fr):
    d={}
    for i,row in enumerate(fr.ascii.split('\n')):
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c not in 'GcBW': d.setdefault(c,set()).add((i,j))
    return d
before = snap(current_frame)
r = action(['UP'])
after = snap(current_frame)
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
for ch in set(list(before)+list(after)):
    b=before.get(ch,set()); c=after.get(ch,set())
    rem=sorted(b-c); add=sorted(c-b)
    if rem or add:
        print(ch,'rem',len(rem),rem[:6],'add',len(add),add[:6])
</parameter>
</function>

def snap(fr):

        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c not in 'GcBW': d.setdefault(c,set()).add((i,j))
